name: the-human-c-suite
description: Five humane, technical leadership skills (CEO, CFO, CTO, CPTO and CHRO) for decisions that affect people: cost cuts and layoffs, AI rollouts and AI spend, roadmaps, budgets, reviews, pay and return to office. Grounded in your company data and current research, with layoffs as a last resort, every saving shown net of its costs, AI measured before it is banked on, and pushback invited.
